AUTHOR: Garcia
TITLE: Automatic segmentation of fish using deep learning with application to fish size measurement
REGION: North Sea (R/V Dr Fridtjof Nansen, March 2017) and Norwegian Sea (F/V Vendla, May 2017); pelagic trawl, Deep Vision in-trawl stereo camera
SPECIES: Single 'fish' class; images contain saithe, blue whiting, redfish, Atlantic mackerel, velvet belly lanternshark, Norway pout (dataset 1); mackerel, blue whiting, herring + northern krill (dataset 2)
DATA: Own Deep Vision stereo images: dataset 1 = 1,605 annotated images from 3 hauls (138,055 stereo pairs); dataset 2 = 200 annotated images from 1 haul (28,117 pairs); 2,629 fish annotations
V_EV: Methods: 'Lighting was provided by two synchronized strobes producing 18 000 lumen each at a colour of 4100 K'; Fig. 1: fish 'maintain at least 20 cm distance from the cameras and lights'
D2: Exp. 1: train/val on dataset 1 (80/20), test on dataset 2 (separate cruise); Exp. 2: random 90% (80/20 train/val) / 10% test over both datasets
D_EV: Results: 'training using the 1605 images of dataset 1, and then testing on the 200 annotated images of dataset 2, in which lighting conditions and camera settings have changed'
R_EV: Table 2: 'Experiment 1: results obtained by Mask R-CNN after training with dataset 1 (D#1) and testing with dataset 2 (D#2)'; Results: 'This dataset is completely independent from the images used for training and validation.'
C_EV: no statement found (no detection confidence threshold reported; only the IoU* match threshold 'has been set as 0.7'; FP/FN counts given in Tables 2-3)
E_EV: Methods: 'Finally, the length of the fish is computed exploiting stereo information.'; Discussion: 'The validation of the size measurements is currently being pursuit'
ARCH: Mask R-CNN (COCO pre-trained, fine-tuned, fish vs background) + camera linearization and illumination correction + gradient-based mask refinement + skeleton/RANSAC curve + stereo length
METR: IoU 0.845/0.824, pixel accuracy 0.994/0.984 (single/overlapping fish); custom IoU* 0.76/0.58 (Exp. 1), 0.89/0.79 (Exp. 2); FN/FP counts
NOTE: ENV coded NR because no allowed value fits an in-trawl pelagic (North Atlantic) setting. V3 = illumination (strobe lumen/colour temperature, gain factors reported), V4 = camera-to-subject range (>=20 cm plexiglass canal); no turbidity or depth. Two split designs: Exp. 1 holds out a whole cruise (coded as D1 = 조사일, driving D_ALL = Y and R1 = Y, R2 = 복수: vessel/lighting/camera settings/species composition/season); Exp. 2 is a random image-level 90/10 split with frames from the same hauls (would be D_ALL = N). Within-dataset-1 80/20 train/val unit not stated. Length measurement is produced but not validated against any reference (E5 = 없음, E_ALL = P). FN and FP counts reported per table but no detection confidence threshold; FP attributed to krill (verifier may consider this a false-positive discussion, but it does not map to C5).
